g.text: K = 8 or 12 target UEs, r = 8 interfering UEs
UEs in a 120 deg sector, 50-100 m from the BS
once per configuration (M, K, r) and carrier (3.5 or 28 GHz)
Seed: rng(seed + i) in MATLAB, seed = 0.
It fixes the UE positions and the random
parameters of QuaDRiGa in realization i.
The same seed at 3.5 and 28 GHz gives
the same UE positions at both carriers.
for each realization i: set the seed to 0 + i,
generate H (target UEs) and H-bar (interfering UEs)
configuration A to P: M, C clusters, K,
SNR grid: -10 to 10 dB, step 2 dB
The draws below come from this generator,
in sequence: noise samples, symbols, noise
of the symbols. The fixed-point inverse
draws nothing, so a fixed-point run gets
the same draws as the float run.
take H and H-bar of this realization
(the same channel for every SNR point)
noise covariance from H-bar, IoTh and SNR
S (M x N), shared by LMMSE and BCD-MMSE
HLS code compiled by the Vitis C-simulation
send each matrix through a pipe,
draw 480 symbols per UE (480K) and their noise (generator),
SER of this realization and SNR point:
Monte Carlo loop: for each realization (100)
average the 100 SERs of each SNR point
